# Dottra

> Dottra is a reusable credit facility for eligible salaried workers and government-sponsored students in Zambia. Draw to your mobile money, pay back any time, and get a monthly statement.

Dottra Lending Services Limited, Chingwere 31651, Chunga East, Lusaka, Zambia. PACRA 120251028871.

Key facts:
- Reusable credit facility: one credit limit, draw any amount from K10 up to available credit, paid to mobile money (MTN, Airtel, Zamtel).
- Processing fee: 5% of each draw, minimum K1, deducted from the amount received.
- Monthly charge: 20% of the average daily balance for the calendar month.
- Monthly statement when a balance is owed; payment due 7 days after the statement date. No late fees; an overdue statement temporarily freezes the facility.
- For salaried employees and government-sponsored students at supported Zambian universities. Android app on Google Play.
